title: Invariance of a graph property
statement: Let $v$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $P$ be a Boolean-valued property of graphs on $v$ vertices that is invariant under every permutation of the vertices. Then for every vertex permutation and every encoded graph $G$, the property has the same value on the permuted graph as on $G$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is invariant under every vertex permutation
